title: Yellow Spicy French Chicken Blanquette
description: A spicy and crumbly French dish featuring turmeric powder, perfect for a brunch mood, this halal-friendly blanquette is a twist on traditional Provence cuisine. It combines the flavors of chicken, vegetables, and spices in a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, turmeric powder, thyme, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the creamy sauce.
Reduce the heat to low and let the blanquette simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
